what_success_demonstrates: Survived without death for at least 24000 actual overworld game ticks
Completed at least one native safe-food consumption with positive food or saturation gain
Retained safe-food inventory supplying at least 20 nutrition during the final hold
HP>=10, food>=12 and sampled current safety conditions all held together for 1200 ticks after minimum elapsed_ticks was reached
what_success_does_not_demonstrate: Infinite survival or renewable food production
Reproduction of the old sustainable wheat and rectangular shelter task
An independently constructed or continuously safe permanent base
Safety from every possible future environmental hazard or untargeted nearby mob

observer_semantics.consumption: NumenPlayer.eat copies the real pre-consumption stack, runs vanilla native consumption, and reports to the active observer only when that input stack count decreases; accepted meals also require safeNutrition>0 and positive food or saturation delta.
observer_semantics.reserve: Current body inventory is read server-side; food nutrition includes real FOOD and SUSPICIOUS_STEW_EFFECTS components. Foods with possible harmful effects do not count.
observer_semantics.elapsed_ticks: Overworld getGameTime minus the first authoritative observer sample. getDayTime is not used, so sleep day-clock jumps do not satisfy the elapsed-tick criterion.
observer_semantics.safety: Alive; no fire, lava, fully frozen state, submerged eyes with air<=40, HARMFUL active effects, or alive Mob within Euclidean 16 blocks that targets this body and has line of sight.
observer_semantics.meal_evidence: First 64 meal records plus truncation indicator and independent first_effective_safe_meal preserve the first successful replenishment even after history fills.
observer_semantics.hold: LiveEvalRun requires all success conditions together, uses game_tick for the hold, resets on unmet conditions or an observation gap above 20 ticks, and fails on the first death.

interpretation_limits: Milestones latch when first attained; 4/4 alone is not final success unless the simultaneous hold criterion is also met.
The score uses periodic authoritative snapshots; the final safety claim is bounded by the specified hazard checks and observation cadence.

At nominal 20 TPS, elapsed24000 plus hold1200 implies about21 minutes before success. This is a world-tick requirement, not a guarantee about wall-clock duration; the1700-second wall budget allows nominally440 seconds beyond that minimum, while calls/tokens may exhaust earlier.
The initial food14/saturation0 is an explicit published fixture, not a hidden mid-run intervention.

comparability.reason: Both the public objective and scoring conditions changed. Keep v1 records as separate historical results; do not combine1/6 with v2 four-milestone scores or claim a same-task score gain.
